content.text:
I found no working photoanode: all three samples I measured gave 0 A photocurrent. I submitted index 14, but that's only a tie-break, not a real winner.

| Index | Mg / Mn fraction | Why I picked it | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 0.33 / 0.67 | MgMn₂O₄ spinel composition. MACE says it's stable (on the hull); MEGNet predicts a 2.87 eV band gap, below the 3.22 eV light, so it should absorb. | 0 A |
| 26 | 0.81 / 0.19 | Mg-rich end, also the Gaussian-process model's suggestion. Mg₃MnO₄ is predicted at a 2.24 eV gap, so it should absorb too. | 0 A |
| 0 | 0.12 / 0.88 | Mn-rich end, the one region left untested. MgMn₆O₁₂ is predicted at a 2.11 eV gap. | 0 A |

Every sample I tested should absorb this light, going by the predicted band gaps, yet none produced current. These three points cover the middle and both ends of the composition line, so the library looks inactive under these conditions. But I measured only 3 of 28 compositions, so a narrow active pocket between them can't be ruled out.

I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements. They would have shown which phases actually formed, but they wouldn't have changed any measured result.
